content.title: Luxury Cleanser Proof | Bathroom Trust, Use Process, Texture and Packshot
content.summary: A field medic proves a hand-cleaning pump through dose, lather and rinse. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One product and one user remain fixed. + A measured dose precedes application. + Texture change remains visibly verifiable. + Rinsing removes the applied material. + The final result returns to the complete product.
quick_start.recommended_input: Have one adult field medic present an original charcoal hand-cleaning pump in a bright mobile clinic. She rubs both hands until a thin visible lather covers fingers and backs of hands. Show the clean-hand result, then hold the complete original pump beside the exact line READY TO RETURN.
